entry_points.text: Per-VCPU dispatcher holds VCPU and routes LAPIC, interrupts, CPUID, regs, MCE, events, debug, XSAVE, XCRS, TSC, pause, caps, nested, Xen, special regs, device attrs and encryption.
Xen per-VCPU set and get for info, time, runstate, id, timer and vector; adjust is write-only.
VM ioctl multiplexes clock, irqchip, timer, Xen and encryption; VM caps need zero flags; compat only MSR filter; VCPU unlocked only encryption.
VCPU fault always bus error; host cache activation checks user range; power maps suspend prepare to pause.

exports.text: Reports total pending NMIs as software plus virtual.
Exposes arch VM and VCPU ioctl, suspend, compat filter, and Xen HVM accessors.

hazards.text: User copies fault, allocs exhaust, malformed fail invalid, oversize reports too big, missing hooks fail, missing stats unsupported, unknown Xen not-found; bank index needs hardening and APIC period guards overflow.

Restore without payload conflates and may morph injected to pending; busy or disabled uncorrected escalates to triple fault; hugepage disable is host-wide with root needed; port exhaustion reports exists and release defers past grace.

invariants.text: Injection needs no held vector plus APIC acceptance; window adds arch delivery, no reinjection and no pending exception. Interrupt ioctl bounds vector and splits by irqchip; NMI always succeeds; TPR rejects nonzero flags.

MCE setup checks bank count and capability bits then inits controls. No-action updates status without exception. Injection validates index, drops disabled, triple-faults when busy or disabled, else records with overflow.

Event get drains NMI/SMI, hides software exceptions, conflates without payload, and reports interrupt, NMI, SMM, init and flags. Set rejects bad flags and vectors, installs fields, reconciles SMM and nested exit, gates triple fault, and requests event.
XSAVE get copies guest-enabled plus FP/vector with confidential handling; set strips disable bits then delegates. XCRS get empties without host support else mask; set honors only that entry.

TSC attrs support only offset; read returns L1 offset and update scales, captures base and syncs. Clock get returns snapshot; set validates flags, avoids step back, and derives offset from master or base.

Legacy XSAVE refused when oversize; sized transfer uses current size. TSC rate refused when protected or at max, zero selects host. Nested save reports length on overflow and restore restricts flags. Special regs refused when protected; encryption needs hook.

Pause needs paravirtual time. VCPU caps reject nonzero flags and gate controller, enlightened, flush and CPUID. VM caps validate masks, often need no VCPUs, and store platform, payload, triple-fault, MSR, hypercall, bus-lock, SGX, PMU, max id and notify.

Xen info/time use cache with sentinel or zero deactivating and success queuing clock update; runstate needs stats with sum and monotonicity; id bounded, timer needs priority with stop before change and arm only when port and expiry nonzero, vector zero or at least sixteen. HVM covers mode, shared info, vector, version and runstate.

TSS reserves three pages; identity, boot id, TSC, notify, hugepage, APIC, chip and timer serialize and mostly change only before VCPUs. Compat widens addresses. Suspend marks all paused. Dirty sync kicks VCPUs. Timer needs PIC; chip access needs present chip; encryption needs hooks.

Dispatch treats reset global, validates port, routes deassign/update/empty, rejects others. Assign allows only local and interdomain with loopback or guest port or event file. Update needs matching type with unchanged port and priority.
Relies on external user copy, locking, atomics, allocation, barriers, timers, stats, overflow, privilege, event file, and hardening helpers.

locks.text: Timestamp holds write lock with interrupts saved; nested, VAPIC and events hold SRCU; MMU holds slot mutex; quirk, split, suppression, PMU, max id, notify, hugepage, APIC, identity, chip, timer, boot id and TSC hold VM or machine lock.
Xen set holds mutex plus SRCU, get holds only mutex; HVM and ports hold Xen lock with sleepable activation and grace separating removal from release.

state_machines.text: NMI folds queued into bounded pending, offers one to virtual mechanism and requests event on remainder; total is software plus virtual and restore replaces queued count.
Nested save fits or reports required length; restore gated on support and flags; chip creation goes absent to present via PIC then IOAPIC then routing with cleanup before publishing.

Runstate mapping uses first-page plus overflow caches with sentinel deactivating; timer query cancels, injects pending, samples, then rearms idempotently; ports go assign to update to deassign with reset collecting before grace.

structs.text: Objects include debug, XSAVE, XCRS, caps, nested, special regs, interrupt irq, TPR, MCE bank and status, events with exception and payloads, XCRS entries, compat ranges, Xen union, runstate counters, timer tuple, and cache addresses.

ABI limits and ids cover interrupts, MCE banks, event valid bits, TSC group and offset, event requests, unmapped sentinels, vector floor, VCPU max, runstate sizing, MMU minimum, TSS reserve, and compat ioctl.
